document_metadata.title: 4、EXT. LAKESIDE- MORNING
document_metadata.summary: Jack and Ingrid find a dead man on a frozen lake; Jack hides evidence, sends Ingrid for help, then shoots her when she leaves, stepping over her body without looking back.

document_metadata.title: 78、EXT. WOODS- DAY
document_metadata.summary: Jack and Mathilde share a rare moment; he admits he's never brought anyone here, hinting at isolation. A fleeting butterfly and sudden wild boar interrupt their picnic, cutting the intimacy short.

entities.name: Mathilde loads jacketed rounds into the magazine and assumes a shooting stance
entities.description: Mathilde inserts two jacketed rounds into the magazine of her firearm and positions herself with her feet apart, braced for firing under the walnut tree.

entities.name: Mathilde fires two rounds at the target
entities.description: Mathilde discharges her weapon twice, the sound marked by 'CHOOP! CHOOP!', and briefly maintains her aim before lowering the gun.

entities.name: Mathilde praises Mr. Clarke and thanks him
entities.description: Mathilde verbally acknowledges Mr. Clarke's work, expressing gratitude by saying, 'You've done a good job, Mr. Clarke. Thank you. Thank you very much.'

entities.name: Mathilde adjusts the telescopic sight with her fingernail
entities.description: Mathilde makes a small calibration to the vertical screw of the rifle's telescopic sight using her fingernail, likely adjusting for precision.

entities.name: Mathilde fully reloads and fires three rounds at the target
entities.description: After adjusting the sight, Mathilde reloads the magazine and fires three rapid shots, marked by 'CHOOP-CHOOP-CHOOP!', at the target.

entities.name: Jack observes the target through binoculars
entities.description: Jack uses binoculars to examine the target, which is shaped like a Boeing 747-400 and features a silhouette of a man with three bullet holes in the head.

entities.name: Mathilde fires four additional rounds at the target
entities.description: With 28 rounds remaining, Mathilde takes aim and fires four rapid shots, destroying the silhouette's head and scattering fragments of cardboard.

entities.name: Mathilde reloads the magazine with lead rounds and hands the weapon to Jack
entities.description: Mathilde fills the magazine with lead rounds, secures it into the SOCIMI rifle, and passes the weapon to Jack.

entities.name: Mathilde instructs Jack to fire two bursts into the bush with yellow flowers
entities.description: Mathilde directs Jack to shoot two bursts of fire into a specific bush marked by yellow flowers, with five seconds between bursts.

entities.name: Jack walks to the stones and prepares to fire
entities.description: Jack slowly moves to the stones near Mathilde, turns to face her, and readies himself to fire the weapon, aware of the hidden Citroen and Mathilde's presence.

entities.name: Jack fires two rounds near Mathilde at her instruction
entities.description: Jack aims the SOCIMI rifle at the yellow flowers beside Mathilde, holds his breath, and fires two shots, deliberately missing her and the flowers.

entities.name: Jack fires a second burst, cutting two yellow blossoms
entities.description: After a brief pause and internal struggle, Jack fires three more rounds, two of which strike and fell stems of yellow blossoms near Mathilde.

entities.name: Jack walks back to the car, visibly relieved
entities.description: Following the second burst, Jack slowly returns to the Citroen, showing signs of emotional release after completing the trust-based shooting test.

entities.name: beneath the walnut tree
entities.description: A shaded area under a walnut tree where Mathilde and the Citroen are positioned, serving as a key location for the shooting scene.

entities.name: the stones
entities.description: A specific rocky area where Jack walks to and fires from, acting as a physical marker in the scene.

entities.name: the bush with the yellow flowers
entities.description: A distinct vegetation feature used as a target during Jack's shooting test, located near Mathilde.

entities.name: Mathilde
entities.description: A skilled markswoman who conducts a shooting exercise and tests Jack's trust by having him fire near her.
entities.summary: A woman, previously encountered by Jack at a cafe, travels with him through an alpine landscape, appearing well-kept but perceived as ruthless and dangerous, with tension growing between them as they discuss nearby houses before she exits the car.

entities.name: Jack
entities.description: A participant in a firearms exercise who is tested by Mathilde to assess his trust and composure under pressure.
entities.summary: A former US Army Special Forces operative in his mid-forties, marked by a tattoo and tactical expertise, navigates danger in snowy landscapes, confronts armed threats, disables a Mercedes, and flees across multiple locations with calculated precision.

entities.description: Optical instrument used by Jack to observe the target after shots are fired.

entities.description: A figure depicted standing in the doorway of the airplane target, representing the primary aim point for Mathilde's shots.

entities.name: Mathilde retrieves a manilla envelope from her sports bag
entities.description: Mathilde takes a plain brown manilla envelope from her sports bag and presents it to Jack, indicating items and modifications needed.

entities.name: Mathilde requests modifications to the weapon and specifies delivery details
entities.description: Mathilde instructs Jack to adjust the sight screws, lengthen the stock, and provide a sixty-round magazine, while also specifying the return date for the weapon and ammunition.

entities.name: Jack advises on the potential imbalance from modifications
entities.description: Jack warns Mathilde that the requested modifications, particularly the larger magazine, may upset the weapon's balance.

entities.name: Mathilde approves the modifications despite balance concerns
entities.description: Mathilde acknowledges the risk to balance but confirms she is prepared to accept it, authorizing Jack to proceed.

entities.name: Jack confirms compliance with Mathilde's requests
entities.description: Jack expresses willingness to carry out all of Mathilde's requested modifications and arrangements.

entities.name: Mathilde and Jack discuss the specifications for a briefcase
entities.description: Jack proposes a standard black Samsonite briefcase with combination locks, and Mathilde selects the combination number 8-2-1.

entities.name: Jack wanders through the park at dawn in a sleep-deprived state
entities.description: Jack, visibly exhausted and affected by insomnia, moves aimlessly through a quiet park near Castel Del Monte's town square shortly after dawn, evoking a sense of inner turmoil and spiritual desolation.

entities.name: Father Benedetto greets Jack and joins him on the walk
entities.description: From twenty meters away, Father Benedetto calls out 'Buon giorno' and raises his hand in a gesture that blends welcome and blessing, then falls into step beside Jack, beginning a contemplative conversation.

entities.name: Father Benedetto explains his weekly meditative walk
entities.description: Father Benedetto describes how he walks in the park every Wednesday as a spiritual practice, treating certain trees as symbolic stations where he offers thanks and prayers for divine gifts such as friendship.

entities.name: Father Benedetto prays at the Cypress tree
entities.description: Upon reaching a Cypress tree during their walk, Father Benedetto bows his head in silent prayer, observing a personal ritual of reflection and devotion.

entities.name: Father Benedetto reflects on the park's role in secret liaisons
entities.description: With a tone of melancholy, Father Benedetto muses aloud about how the park, visited by others at night, may have been the site of illicit relationships resulting in illegitimate children, giving a knowing glance to Jack.

entities.name: Father Benedetto questions Jack about his intentions to leave
entities.description: Father Benedetto suggests that Jack plans to leave the town, citing their previous conversation and observing that those who seek peace are often transient and burdened by sin.

entities.name: Jack considers staying in the valley after contemplative dialogue
entities.description: After a reflective exchange with Father Benedetto about sin, peace, and movement, Jack expresses uncertainty about leaving and tentatively considers remaining in the region, moved by the landscape and conversation.
